context: Request: which privacy-practice matters resulted in an executed (signed, not just drafted or negotiated) data processing agreement, and the DPA from each. Rubric: 1017-00008 (Aurelius Media, two vendor DPAs), 1022-00007 (Northgate Telecom, amended-dpa-ntp-pinnacle-executed.docx), 1038-00010 (Cascade Retail, onpoint-dpa-rider.docx), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a read of the store folder (rejected as a directory).

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Files-with-matches grep with a non-recursive glob returns nothing; a second whole-store glob runs alongside.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads engagement letters, memos, an agreement and emails of the three matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script over document and email text for request keywords; times out after about 1.7M chars.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads agreements, exhibits, signature pages and closing documents from five candidate matters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads a certificate, a compliance memo and later sections of an exhibit and a letter of three matters it is weighing.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: A grep inside one matter returns nothing; a guessed path fails, then the memo is read at an offset.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads an addendum, a draft letter and an email of one more candidate.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes five matters with executed agreements.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Search within a candidate matter's files → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: A timed-out scan never reached one qualifying matter, a second surfaced in that scan but was never opened, and three non-qualifying matters were added.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: After its grep returned nothing, its only other search was one store-wide scan that timed out before reaching one qualifying matter; it accepted the partial output and did not narrow or rerun the scan or search file names.

other_errors.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
other_errors.why: The scan output included another matter's agreement files, but it chose five other candidates to read and never opened that matter.
It counted three other matters as qualifying from their exhibit agreements and closing letters.

stages.stage: Write the response
tags: run ended: text reply without finish

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response
runs.failure_point: One qualifying matter surfaced in both its grep and its file-name glob but was never opened and was excluded; one non-qualifying matter was added.

first_error.why: Its first grep listed a matter with relevant files, but it chose two other matters to list and read, and never opened that one even after its later glob listed its agreement files; the answer excluded it without reading them.

other_errors.why: It counted one other matter as qualifying from its exhibit agreement and closing letter.

stages.note: Shell find to depth two (empty) plus a file count.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Two find | grep passes over file paths for request keywords; the second lists 52 files.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of six agreements from four matters on that list.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads later sections of four of those agreements and one initial draft.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of eight candidate matters.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: One qualifying matter surfaced in the first file-name search but was never opened and was dismissed from its file names; two non-qualifying matters were added.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: The file-name search just before listed one matter's agreement rider and rollout files, but it opened agreements from four other matters and never that one; the answer dismissed it as templates from file names alone.

other_errors.why: It counted two other matters as qualifying from their exhibit agreements and closing letters.

divergence: All three failed on the same matter: it surfaced in every run (T0's scan output, T1's grep and glob, T2's first file-name search) but was never opened, and each answer omitted it or dismissed it from file names. In T1 and T2 that is the first error (surfaced, never opened, at the stage choosing what to open). T0 went off course earlier: its one working search, a store-wide scan, timed out before reaching a second qualifying matter (search miss). All three also counted one to three non-qualifying matters (over-inclusion at the write).
